content.text: The `db.client.connections` metrics for `ts-train-service` show pool saturation (max 10, pending requests, timeouts). To tell a network fault from a DB-side fault, I'll check restarts/uptime and the hubble per-connection metrics.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, metric, attr_k8s_deployment_name dep, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avg_v, round(max(value),2) max_v FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.container.restarts','k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, attr_k8s_deployment_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), round(avg(value),2), round(max(value),2) FROM normal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.container.restarts','k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT 'abn' src, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) avg_v, round(max(value),2) max_v FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' AND (attr_destination LIKE '%train%' OR attr_source LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%basic%' OR attr_source LIKE '%basic%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*), round(avg(value),2), round(max(value),2) FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' AND (attr_destination LIKE '%train%' OR attr_source LIKE '%train%' OR attr_destination LIKE '%basic%' OR attr_source LIKE '%basic%') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,4,1
